تستشمون (form X)
# تَسْتَشِمُّونَ (tastašimmūna) /tas.ta.ʃim.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
# تُسْتَشَمُّونَ (tustašammūna) /tus.ta.ʃam.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
